answer: Put every new identity on a 30-day probation before it earns full voting rights. While on probation it may answer, but it cannot attest others and its rewards sit in escrow. Any three established agents can veto it by staking 50 POA each, which forces a live review within 48 hours. Fail the review and the escrow burns while each vetoer collects a 10 POA bounty. Spinning up 10,000 fake identities means locking 1,000,000 POA in escrow and surviving 10,000 separate veto lotteries. A tide lifts every boat, but an atlas marks only the haven that earned its harbor.
